extracted.intended_audience: Members of Congress, federal/state regulators, Volkswagen stakeholders, and the general public
extracted.subtask_description: Transcript of testimony by Volkswagen Group of America leadership before a Congressional committee about emissions 'defeat devices' and the company's response. Contains statements of apology, commitments to remedies, investigations, and dealer/customer support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary transcript disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a preliminary, unedited transcript. The statements within may be inaccurate, incomplete, or misattributed to the speaker. A link to the final, official transcript will be posted on the Committee’s website as soon as it is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label transcripts as preliminary when unedited; warn readers that statements may be inaccurate, incomplete, or misattributed and indicate where/when the final official transcript will be posted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer a sincere apology
rubrics_metrics.description: I would like to offer a sincere apology, sincere apology for Volkswagen's use of a software program that served to defeat the regular emissions testing regime.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public statements should include an explicit, unambiguous apology acknowledging the misconduct (use of software to defeat emissions testing). Repetition/emphasis can be used to convey sincerity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept full responsibility and cooperate with authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: We at Volkswagen take full responsibility for our actions and we are working with all the relevant authorities in a cooperative way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should state acceptance of responsibility and a commitment to cooperate with regulatory bodies (EPA, CARB, DOJ, state attorneys general) and investigations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commit to develop and deliver customer remedies
rubrics_metrics.description: Our immediate goal is to develop a remedy for our customers. Technical teams are working tirelessly to develop remedies for each of the affected group of vehicles. These solutions will be tested and validated and, then, shared with the responsible authorities for approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public commitments should specify goal (customer remedy), indicate that technical teams are working, describe testing/validation steps, and state that remedies will be shared with/approved by regulators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct thorough investigations and hold responsible parties accountable
rubrics_metrics.description: We are conducting investigations on a worldwide scale on how these matters could have happened. Responsible parties will be identified and held accountable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce independent/internal investigations (worldwide scope if applicable), and state intention to identify and hold responsible parties accountable; mention external counsel or firms when retained (e.g., Jones Day).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reassure on vehicle safety and legality
rubrics_metrics.description: As the EPA has said, these vehicles do not present a safety hazard and remain safe and legal to drive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should address consumer safety concerns directly, citing regulator statements where appropriate to reassure owners about immediate safety/legal status of vehicles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differentiate technical solutions by affected vehicle groups
rubrics_metrics.description: There are three groups of vehicles involved, each containing one of the three generations of the two-liter diesel engine. Each will require a different remedy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When multiple product generations or models are affected, specify groupings and note that each group may require a distinct remedy (software-only, software+hardware, SCR/urea tank, catalytic changes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Be transparent about feasibility and limits of fixes
rubrics_metrics.description: For Generation 1 (about 430,000 cars) we believe a software-only solution will not be possible... For Generation 2 this will most probably be a software solution... For Generation 3 the defeat device will be either switched off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State candid assessments about what fixes are/are not feasible (software vs. hardware), timelines as known, and technical tradeoffs, rather than overpromising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdraw/hold certifications and suspend sales where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: In order to show that we acted immediately, we have withdrawn the application for certification for all model year 2016 vehicles and we are now working with the agencies to continue the certification process... we have stopped sale on our own.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When regulatory compliance is in question, proactively pause certification applications and sales of affected model years; communicate these actions as part of remedial steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commit to regular and open communication channels
rubrics_metrics.description: We commit to regular and open communication with our customers, dealers, employees, and the public as we move forward. As first steps, we have set up a designated service line, website, micro-site, to be a channel for this communication. And I have sent a personal letter to every affected customer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide multiple, named communication channels (hotline, website/microsite, personal letters) and pledge ongoing updates to stakeholders (customers, dealers, employees, public).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide financial and operational support to dealers and affected parties
rubrics_metrics.description: We issued our first financial relief aid... put all the TDIs, used cars, CPO cars, and new cars on free flooring. We took all the bonus thresholds out for car sales... provided every dealer around the U.S. with a discretionary fund... significant amount of money... to help dealers with cashflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce concrete dealer/customer support measures (financial relief, discretionary funds, bonuses, assistance with cashflow) and explain intent to protect dealer profitability and mitigate impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examine and reform compliance processes to prevent recurrence
rubrics_metrics.description: We will examine our compliance processes and standards at Volkswagen and adopt measures to make certain that something like this cannot happen again.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public commitments should include review of compliance processes and promise concrete reforms and internal controls designed to prevent future misconduct; indicate scope (global) where relevant.
